review: Pizza crust was thin and crispy, toppings were fresh. Drinks a bit overpriced.
Cozy place, great music, and the staff remembered us from last time. Best date night spot in Koramangala.
Booked for a team dinner of 12 and they handled it really well. Food came out together and hot.
Lovely interiors and the rooftop seating is beautiful. Service was slow but the pizza was worth it.
Nice place, decent food, but waiting 30 mins for a table even with a reservation is not ok.
The lasagna was amazing and the staff were super friendly. Came on a Tuesday, no wait at all.
Value for money, especially the weekday lunch combo. Desserts are a must.
Waited 25 minutes just to place our order. The waiter seemed overwhelmed. Tiramisu was good though.
Risotto was rich and flavourful, desserts were excellent. Bit pricey but fine for a special occasion.
Worst service ever. Order took over an hour, half of it came wrong and the bill had extra items.
Excellent service, our server Ravi recommended the lamb shank and it was perfect. Will be back.
Food was good but we waited 40 minutes for our mains on a Saturday night. Nobody told us why.
The rooftop view at sunset is lovely. Drinks were good, food average.
Panna cotta and tiramisu both brilliant. Main course was ok.
Pasta was decent, nothing special. Desserts made up for it though, the panna cotta was lovely.
The chocolate fondant is to die for. Service was attentive without being pushy.
Lovely ambience, soft lighting and not too loud. The mushroom risotto was creamy and well seasoned. Parking was a nightmare though.
Weekday lunch was quick and the food was delicious. Great spot for a work lunch.
Booked a table for 8pm, got seated at 8:35. Staff were polite but clearly understaffed.
Ambience is gorgeous but service is painfully slow on weekends. Had to ask three times for water.
Ambience is nice but the AC was way too cold. Food was ok.
Came here for my sister's birthday and the tiramisu was honestly the best I've had in Bangalore. Staff were warm and quick.
Had to circle the block 20 mins for parking. Food was good but the whole experience started on a bad note.
Food is great and prices are fair for the portion size. Only complaint is there's no proper parking nearby.
Good vegetarian options, the pesto gnocchi was a highlight. Wine list is limited.
Food is fine but the place is getting crowded and noisy on weekends.
Beautiful decor for the festive season. Service was super quick even on a Saturday.
Bruschetta and the house salad were fresh. Parking still a pain, use the mall basement.
Our pasta was cold and it took forever to arrive. Expected better at this price.
Hosted a small birthday on the rooftop, staff decorated the table and the cake was delicious.
Two of our pastas were cold. Manager comped dessert which was nice, but kitchen needs to fix this.
Staff are polite but there just aren't enough of them. Took 20 mins to get the bill.
Lovely decor, average pasta, very slow service. Desserts are the only reason I'd return.
Prices went up a bit this month but quality is still good. Loved the new seasonal soup.
Again a long wait on Sunday. Food is good but I'm not sure it's worth the 45 minute delay.
Pizza was tasty but the waiter forgot our drinks twice. Weekend service needs serious improvement.
Solid food, friendly staff, reasonable bill. The garlic bread is addictive.
Hands down the best desserts in the area. The tiramisu and the lemon tart are both incredible.
Came on a weekday, service was quick and the food was spot on. The tiramisu is a must try.
Great atmosphere and lovely staff. The carbonara was slightly cold when it arrived but tasted good.
The new menu has some great additions, loved the truffle fries. Service a bit slow as usual.
Waited 50 mins, food arrived cold, and nobody apologised. Not coming back on a weekend.
Penne arrebiata was cold in the middle, like it was reheated. Desserts still great.
45 minute wait for two pizzas. The pizza was good but the experience was frustrating.
Still my favourite italian place. Tiramisu never disappoints and the staff are always friendly.
The pasta came out lukewarm and the sauce had gone gluey. Told the waiter, he apologised but nothing was done.
Decent food, great desserts, terrible wait times on Saturday.
Loved the ambience and the music. Gnocchi was soft and the sauce was perfect.
Prices are reasonable for Indiranagar. The rooftop is the best part.
Celebrated our anniversary here, the staff brought a candle on the dessert without us asking. So sweet.
